name: page-turn
title: Page Turn
description: The outgoing scene lifts off like a page and rotates up out of the frame in a few stepped poses, uncovering the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pgt-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A tactile, stop-motion style page flip between chapters or slides.
The deck or story metaphor is a book, notebook or magazine.
avoidWhen: You want smooth, continuous motion: use a slide or wipe.
The pages carry fine detail that stepped poses would stutter.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Angle
variables.description: Rotation reached at the end of the lift, in degrees.

variables.label: Poses
variables.description: How many stepped poses the lift is held in (1 is a single jump).

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: CSS transform-origin of the page (the hinge).
